_readme: Values that are legitimately IDENTICAL to en.json in a target locale, so that
`node scripts/i18n-parity.mjs` can warn about every OTHER identical value —
which is an untranslated string, not a coincidence.
Seeded 2026-08-21 from the identical set of the locale files as they stand
after the i18n remediation (the 2026-08-20 audit's list of 87, minus the
values Tasks 3-17 translated, plus values those tasks introduced).
Only five reasons are accepted, and each entry states one:
format     - the value is placeholders/punctuation only; nothing to translate
unit       - a unit, symbol or colour-space name written the same everywhere
identifier - an ALL-CAPS UI label or a game/data field name used as a token
brand      - a product, company or legally-fixed string
cognate    - the correct translation happens to be the same word
Adding an entry is a translation decision: if the value is real prose, translate
it instead. Entries that stop being identical are reported as STALE.
